component-o.description-s: 2.7 V to 5.5 V 0.5 A single-channel current-limited power switch, 95 mOhm, 0.8 A typ limit, active-high enable, open-drain fault flag, reverse blocking, SOT25; microSD card power switch

cfgpins-ao.3c: FLG: open-drain over-current / over-temperature flag, active low, 7 ms deglitch (Pin Descriptions p2). Unused here: left open. Wire it to a host input with a 10k pull-up (Typical Applications Circuit p2) to report card faults.

cfgpins-ao.4c: EN active high (AP2151), do not float: driven by the host's card-power GPIO (ds-sd_pwr-rx). VIH 2 V min, VIL 0.8 V max (Recommended Operating Conditions p3), so a 1.8 V GPIO cannot drive it; same 2 V threshold as the SY6280AAC it replaces.

source-o.table-s: Electrical Characteristics (TA 25 C, VIN 5 V): RDS(ON) 95 / 115 mOhm (SOT25, 0.5 A), ILIMIT 0.6 / 0.8 / 1.0 A (-40 to 85 C), ISHORT 0.6 A, IQ 45 uA, tR 0.6 ms, TSHDN 140 C, RthJA SOT25 157 C/W; Recommended Operating Conditions p3: VIN 2.7-5.5 V, IOUT 0-500 mA; IN / OUT bypass 0.01-0.1 uF ceramic (p10)

component-o.replaces_s: SY6280AAC (Silergy, not at DigiKey / Mouser / Newark): same SOT-23-5 OUT/GND/-/EN/IN pin order and 2 V EN threshold; pin 3 is a fault flag instead of ISET (fixed 0.6-1.0 A limit, no Rset); 0.5 A continuous

source-o.source-note-s: Mouser API read through the pcbparts lookup (procurement Mouser key invalid). DigiKey stocks 67070 but its lookup shows only the 3000-piece reel AP2151WGDITR-ND
